'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Insurgency in Manipur]]
**[[2023 Manipur violence]]
***Ethnic violence breaks out between the [[Meitei people|Meitei]] and the [[Kuki people|Kuki Zo]] people in the state of [[Manipur]].  [https://indianexpress.com/article/north-east-india/manipur/curfew-internet-curbs-after-manipur-protest-against-meiteis-st-tag-demand-turns-violent-8590104/ (The Indian Express)]
*[[Russo-Ukrainian war (2022–present)|Russo-Ukrainian war]]
**[[Attacks in Russia during the Russo-Ukrainian war (2022–present)|Attacks in Russia during the Russo-Ukrainian war]]
***[[Kremlin drone attack]]
****[[Russia]] accuses [[Ukraine]] of attempting to assassinate [[President of Russia|President]] [[Vladimir Putin]] after two drones were shot down near the [[Kremlin]]. A spokesman claimed that Putin was not inside the Kremlin at the time of the attack. A video shows at least one drone hitting the compound. Ukraine denies any involvement in the attack. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-65471904 (BBC News)]
**[[Crimea attacks (2022–present)|Crimea attacks]]
***Russia's [[Federal Security Service]] says that it has arrested seven [[Foreign Intelligence Service of Ukraine|Ukrainian agents]] who were allegedly planning a "series of high-profile sabotage and terrorist acts" in [[Crimea]], including an attack on the [[Head of the Republic of Crimea]] [[Sergey Aksyonov]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/russias-fsb-says-7-ukrainian-agents-arrested-crimea-2023-05-03/ (Reuters)]
**[[Russian attacks on civilians in the Russo-Ukrainian war (2022–present)|Russian attacks on civilians in the Russo-Ukrainian war]]
***[[Russian Armed Forces|Russian forces]] shell [[Kherson Oblast]], killing 16 [[civilian]]s and injuring 22 others. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/three-civilians-killed-russian-attack-ukrainian-hypermarket-officials-2023-05-03/ (Reuters)]
*[[Sudanese civil war (2023–present)|Sudanese civil war]]
**[[Evacuation of foreign nationals during the Sudanese civil war]]
***[[Australia]]'s [[Royal Australian Air Force]] evacuates 36 Australians from [[Sudan]], reportedly overnight. [https://www.smh.com.au/national/australians-still-trapped-in-worsening-sudan-crisis-20230429-p5d48e.html (''Sydney Morning Herald'')] [https://www.abc.net.au/news/2023-05-03/australian-rescue-mission-flight-out-of-sudan/102295460 (ABC News Australia)]
**The [[South Sudan]]ese foreign ministry announces that a seven-day [[ceasefire]] has been agreed to in Sudan, lasting from May 4 to 11. [https://www.firstpost.com/world/sudans-waring-parties-agree-to-seven-day-truce-starting-4-may-12538932.html (Firstpost)] [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/sudan-conflict-drives-100000-over-border-amid-crumbling-ceasefires-2023-05-02/ (Reuters)]
*The [[Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps]] seize the [[Panama]]-flagged [[oil tanker]] ''Niovi'' in the [[Strait of Hormuz]]. [https://www.tasnimnews.com/en/news/2023/05/03/2889051/irgc-seizes-foreign-tanker-for-law-breaking (Tasnim News Agency)]

'''Business and economy'''
*The [[World Bank]]'s board of governors elects [[United States|American]] business executive [[Ajay Banga]] as the next [[President of the World Bank Group]]. [https://www.reuters.com/business/finance/world-bank-board-poised-elect-us-nominee-ajay-banga-president-2023-05-03/ (Reuters)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2023 Africa floods]]
**Floods have killed 109 people in [[Rwanda]] and six people in [[Uganda]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/floods-heavy-rains-kill-least-55-rwanda-state-broadcaster-2023-05-03/ (Reuters)]
*[[2023 Emilia-Romagna floods]]
**Two people are killed, one is missing and several are displaced during heavy [[flood]]s in the [[Emilia-Romagna]] region, [[Italy]]. [https://apnews.com/article/floods-agriculture-drought-deaths-italy-30ec2bfd7d3efc3491c9f12024b6c181 (AP)]
*Seventeen people are killed and 29 others are injured after a public bus and a truck collide with each other on a highway in [[New Valley Governorate]], [[Egypt]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/road-accident-leaves-14-dead-egypt-2023-05-03/ (Reuters)]
*Eight people are killed after a fire breaks out in a construction container in [[Brno]], [[Czech Republic]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/fire-building-containers-kills-eight-people-czech-city-2023-05-04/ (Reuters)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Vladislav Ribnikar Elementary School shooting]]
**A boy kills nine people in a [[mass shooting]] at an [[elementary school]] in [[Belgrade]], [[Serbia]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/boy-opens-fire-serbian-school-suspect-arrested-police-2023-05-03/ (Reuters)]
*[[2023 Atlanta shooting]]
**One person is killed and four others are injured in a [[mass shooting]] at a medical facility in [[Atlanta]], [[Georgia (U.S. state)|Georgia]], [[United States]]. The suspected shooter is later arrested following an 8-hour manhunt. [https://apnews.com/article/atlanta-shooting-midtown-0dadef247e62aa87e9d3422816e995a2 (AP)]
*[[Myanmar]]'s [[State Administration Council]] [[pardon]]s 2,153 [[political prisoner]]s to mark [[Vesak Day]]. [https://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/pardon-frees-2100-myanmar-political-prisoners-99034510 (ABC News)] [https://english.news.cn/20230503/faee5dc996ab4566b364d246b575c9e9/c.html (Xinhua)]
*[[Belarus]]ian [[Belarusian opposition|activist]] and [[blogger]] [[Roman Protasevich]] is [[sentence (law)|sentenced]] to eight years in prison. [https://www.barrons.com/news/belarusian-activist-protasevich-sentenced-to-8-years-in-jail-news-agency-58da9e1f (AFP via ''Barron's'')]

'''Science and technology'''
* Researchers announce the successful extraction of [[ancient DNA]] from a 20,000 year old elk-tooth pendant found in [[Denisova Cave]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/pendant-is-20000-years-old-ancient-dna-shows-who-wore-it-2023-05-03/ (Reuters)]
